cases.goal: Add a --dry-run flag to the export command so it prints what it would write without writing any file.

documents.text:
diff --git a/export.py b/export.py
@@ def main(argv):
-    args = parse(argv)
-    write_files(collect(args))
+    args = parse(argv)
+    files = collect(args)
+    if args.dry_run:  # print the plan, touch nothing
+        for f in files:
+            print(f"would write {f.path} ({len(f.data)} bytes)")
+        return 0
+    write_files(files)
@@ def parse(argv):
+    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print what would be written; write nothing")
diff --git a/tests/test_export.py b/tests/test_export.py
+def test_dry_run_writes_nothing(tmp_path, capsys):
+    main(["--out", str(tmp_path), "--dry-run"])
+    assert list(tmp_path.iterdir()) == []
+    assert "would write" in capsys.readouterr().out

cases.goal: Make the export command skip empty files, and log how many it skipped.

documents.text:
diff --git a/export.py b/export.py
@@ def write_files(files):
+    skipped = 0
     for f in files:
+        if not f.data:  # an empty file is skipped, not written
+            skipped += 1
+            continue
         write(f)
+    log.info("skipped %d empty file(s)", skipped)
diff --git a/tests/test_export.py b/tests/test_export.py
+def test_empty_files_are_skipped(tmp_path, caplog):
+    write_files([File("a", b""), File("b", b"x")], out=tmp_path)
+    assert [p.name for p in tmp_path.iterdir()] == ["b"]
+    assert "skipped 1 empty" in caplog.text
